transcript: Speaker A: पड़ोसन के सामने कूरियर वाले का कॉल आया। इंग्लिश में बात हुई। पड़ोसन हैरान बोली। [The courier guy called in front of the neighbor. Spoke in English. When kids are at school, husband at office, I do it then. Instead of watching reels, I watch this. summary: A woman impresses her neighbor by speaking English with a delivery driver. She explains how she overcame her fear of English using the 'English Seekho' app's AI teacher for 15-20 minutes daily. The ad promotes a ₹1 trial and urges viewers to download the app.
